title: Powhatan Ellis to John Forsyth, No. 9, Mexico, 16 Nov 1839: a coded despatch in the JQA code, with its 1839 clear copy (catalogue 653)

documents.shelfmark: NARA RG 59, Despatches from US Ministers to Mexico vol. 9, M97 roll 10 (naId 189102194), frames 0298, 0299, 0302, 0303; clear copy frames 0300-0301 (catalogue 653)

transcription.notes: Contributed by WAINUT (27 Oct 2026). Every line checked a second time, independently, on full-frame views, about 15 lines on enlarged crops; no disagreement. solution.what: WAINUT contribution: located catalogue 653 on NARA M97 roll 10 frames 0298-0303 (Ellis, Mexico, 16 Nov 1839), in the JQA code (the = 1385), with the Department's clear copy on frames 0300-0301.
WAINUT contribution: 519 groups in 88 lines transcribed, every line checked a second time independently; the clear copy transcribed.

WAINUT contribution: applied ../jqa/code_table.tsv unchanged: 471 of 519 groups valued; joined into letters, the table-only decode recovers 88% of the clear copy's letters (difflib ratio 0.868; shuffled tables 0.12-0.22, shuffled group orders 0.20-0.22).

WAINUT contribution: groups aligned line by line with the 1839 clear copy (ellis1839_pairs.tsv, about 40 pairs): 1261 comma, 1264 full stop (the table has gar, H, 1x), 1067 s, 651 x, 1366 tal, 601 713 Mr.; the copy's 'Toops' repeats the groups' spelling.
WAINUT contribution: wrong-key controls (decode.py --controls): function-word rate 0.28 for the true table, 0.02-0.12 for shifts of 1-100, 0.03 for random table permutations.
WAINUT contribution: Manning, Inter-American Affairs vol. 8 (1937) not reachable (bot check, not bypassed); two web searches found no printed text.
WAINUT contribution: read (ellis1839_reading.md, read_share 1.0), following the groups where they differ from the clear copy.

Maintainer cross-check with Michael Brackx's independent transcription of the same four frames (issue #120, gist data read with our own script): both 519 groups, 505 agree, 14 single groups differ (0298.07 1551/1557, 0298.09 668/1068, 0299.04 145/45, 0299.06 1450/1430, 0299.07 438/1438 and 1361/1261, 0299.16 1570/1510, 0299.18 and 0299.22 451/457, 0302.04 1001/1501, 0302.18 1070/1075, 0303.02 833/03, 0303.06 1216/416, 0303.09 731/721; Brackx first), to be settled on the frames. Of 11 values both propose 10 agree; 401 n (Brackx) against ican (here) unresolved. Status set to in progress: to be merged with Brackx's 1836-40 material into one Ellis folder and written up then.

outcome.method_basis: A complete contemporary clear copy of the whole coded passage (the Department's, frames 0300-0301 of the same volume) exists and was used to fill about 48 groups the table lacks; the work here is the transcription of the groups, their decode with the JQA code table (../jqa/code_table.tsv, applied unchanged) and the alignment with the copy.
outcome.fraction_read_source: ellis1839_reading.md: research/reading_audit/v2_score.py hole rate 0.0; every group lines up with a word or syllable of the clear copy; the two groups illegible on the film rest on the clear copy.

texts.label: Ellis to Forsyth, No. 9, Mexico, 16 Nov 1839 (catalogue 653), M97 roll 10 frames 0298-0303
texts.summary: The US minister in Mexico reports that Texian troops with disaffected Mexicans have crossed the line, apparently to attack Matamoros, and that the government is sending General Arista to the frontier with 4,000 men; a war with Texas would unite the Mexican parties; the foreign minister Cañedo wants a general congress of the Spanish American states, unlikely to succeed. The Department's 1839 clear copy is in the same file.
texts.note: A contemporary decipherment exists (prior solution, used); this entry adds the groups, the decode with the table and the alignment. reading_review left to the maintainer.

outcome.notes: Contributed by WAINUT (catalogue 653). Same code as ../jqa; nothing there is changed. Proposed table changes (not applied) are in NOTES.md and ellis1839_pairs.tsv. Manning, Inter-American Affairs vol. 8 (Mexico, 1937) may print the clear text: not checked (the copy was not reachable).
